title: KafkaEventEnvelopeV1
description: Canonical Kafka event envelope for Contract LM-1.1.1 (MSS-039). Never include JPA entities, passwords, or auth tokens.

eventId.description: Globally unique UUID for consumer deduplication (consumerGroup, eventId).

type.description: Versioned event type matching the canonical Kafka topic name.

occurredAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the domain event occurred.

traceId.description: Bounded correlation ID propagated from X-Trace-Id or generated by job/scheduler.

aggregateId.description: Identifier of the owning aggregate (loanId, bookId, or reservationId) — also used as Kafka message key.

aggregateVersion.description: Monotonic version of the aggregate at event emission time.

payload.description: Event-specific payload containing scalar IDs and UTC timestamps only.
